method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.name: create_payment_request
tools.description: Create a new HitPay payment request. Returns a checkout URL where the customer can complete payment. Supports card, PayNow, GrabPay, FPX, GCash, QRIS, and 10+ other Southeast Asian payment methods. Set generate_qr: true for embedded QR codes — supported methods: paynow_online, shopee_pay, qris, doku_qris, ifpay_qris, wechat, wechat_pay, promptpay, opn_prompt_pay, truemoney, opn_true_money_qr, grabpay_direct, grabpay, grabpay_paylater, upi, upi_qr, gcash, gcash_qr, touch_n_go, atome, vietqr, vietqr_zalopay, zalopay.

currency.description: 3-letter currency code (SGD, MYR, PHP, USD, etc.)

payment_methods.description: Allowed payment methods (e.g., ["card", "paynow_online", "grabpay_direct"]). Defaults to all enabled methods.

generate_qr.description: Generate QR code for QR-based methods (PayNow, GrabPay, etc.)

redirect_url.description: URL to redirect after payment completion

allow_repeated_payments.description: Allow multiple payments on same request

expires_after.description: Relative expiry: "5 minutes", "30 mins", "2 hours", "7 days"

send_email.description: Email receipt to customer after payment

tools.name: get_payment_request
tools.description: Get the status and details of a payment request by its ID. Shows payment status, amount, checkout URL, and any completed payments.

tools.name: list_payment_requests
tools.description: List payment requests with optional filters. Returns paginated results sorted by creation date.

tools.name: update_payment_request
tools.description: Update a pending payment request. Only pending requests can be updated. You can change the amount, purpose, or customer details. Currency is required even if not changing it.

tools.name: delete_payment_request
tools.description: Delete an incomplete/pending payment request. Only requests that have NOT been paid can be deleted. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_charges
tools.description: List payment charges with optional date, status, and keyword filters. Shows transaction history with amounts, fees, payment methods, and customer details. Uses cursor-based pagination.

cursor.description: Cursor for next page (from previous response next_cursor)

date_to.description: Filter charges up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

status.description: Filter by charge status (e.g., succeeded, refunded, failed)

tools.name: get_charge_detail
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific charge by its ID. Shows full transaction details including fees, payment method, and customer info.

tools.name: get_balances
tools.description: Get current account balances grouped by currency. Shows available, deposit, and pending amounts.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Get account verification status and payment provider availability. Shows bank account status, KYC verification progress, and which payment methods are enabled.

tools.name: create_customer
tools.description: Create a new customer record in HitPay. Customers can be associated with payment requests and invoices.

tools.name: list_customers
tools.description: List customers with optional search. Returns customer names, emails, and contact info. Uses cursor-based pagination.

cursor.description: Cursor for next page (from previous response next_cursor)

search.description: Search by name, email, or phone

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific customer by ID.

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a new invoice. Optionally emails it to the customer. Returns the invoice URL for payment.

customer_id.description: Existing customer ID (use instead of email/name)

memo.description: Note or memo on the invoice

send_email.description: Email the invoice to the customer

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with optional filters. Shows invoice amounts, statuses, and customer info. Uses cursor-based pagination.

cursor.description: Cursor for next page (from previous response next_cursor)

status.description: Filter by status (e.g., pending, paid, overdue)

tools.name: create_embedded_qr
tools.description: Create a QR code to collect a payment. Recommended for all QR-based payment collection. Generates a one-time dynamic QR via a payment request — expires after payment. Also supports borderless (cross-border) QR — pass a foreign payment method (e.g., gcash_qr from SG) and the response includes borderless_fx with customer_pays, merchant_receives, fx_rate, and display_rate. Webhook event: payment_request.completed.

currency.description: 3-letter currency code (SGD, MYR, PHP, THB, IDR, INR, etc.)

payment_method.description: Payment method code for the QR. Supported: paynow_online, shopee_pay, doku_qris (ID merchants), ifpay_qris (other merchants), wechat_pay, opn_prompt_pay, opn_true_money_qr, grabpay_direct, grabpay_paylater, upi_qr, gcash_qr, qrph_netbank, touch_n_go, atome

tools.name: create_static_qr
tools.description: Create a permanent static QR code. Reusable physical QR where customers manually enter the amount. Best for in-store, donation drives, or multi-location use. Only supports: paynow_online, upi_qr, qrph_netbank. Webhook event: charge.created (includes static_qr.id and static_qr.reference for reconciliation). For one-time payment QR codes, use create_embedded_qr instead.

name.description: Display name for the static QR code

payment_provider_method.description: Payment method: paynow_online, upi_qr, or qrph_netbank

amount.description: Fixed payment amount (optional — if omitted, customer enters amount)

currency.description: 3-letter currency code (required if amount is set)

tools.name: list_static_qrs
tools.description: List all static QR codes. Returns permanent, reusable QR codes created via create_static_qr.

tools.name: get_static_qr
tools.description: Get full details of a static QR code by its ID. Returns name, QR value, payment method, amount, device_id, and location_id.

tools.name: update_static_qr
tools.description: Update a static QR code. You can change the name, amount, currency, device_id, or location_id.

static_qr_id.description: Static QR code ID to update

amount.description: New fixed amount (omit to keep customer-entered)

currency.description: Currency code (required if amount is set)

tools.name: delete_static_qr
tools.description: Delete a static QR code permanently. This action cannot be undone.

static_qr_id.description: Static QR code ID to delete

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List products in the HitPay product catalog. Shows product names, prices, and stock levels.

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.description: Get account balance summary. Shows available balance by currency.

tools.name: list_subscription_plans
tools.description: List recurring billing / subscription plans. Shows plan names, amounts, billing cycles, and status.

tools.name: get_sales_summary
tools.description: Get aggregated sales analytics for a time period. Shows total sales, fees, average transaction value by currency, top payment methods, and transaction status breakdown. Use period presets or explicit date range.

period.description: Preset period (default: last_30_days). Ignored if date_from/date_to are set.

tools.name: estimate_transfer
tools.description: Preview transfer fees and exchange rate before sending money. Provide either source_amount (how much to send from your account) or payment_amount (how much the beneficiary receives) — not both.

beneficiary_id.description: Beneficiary ID to estimate transfer for

source_currency.description: Source currency from your HitPay balance (SGD, MYR, etc.)

source_amount.description: Amount to debit from your account (provide this OR payment_amount)

payment_amount.description: Amount beneficiary receives (provide this OR source_amount)

tools.name: create_transfer
tools.description: Send money to a beneficiary. IMPORTANT: This initiates a real money transfer from your HitPay balance. Use estimate_transfer first to preview fees and exchange rates. You can reference a saved beneficiary by ID, or provide inline beneficiary details for a one-time transfer.

source_currency.description: Source currency from your HitPay balance

beneficiary_id.description: Saved beneficiary ID (use this OR provide inline beneficiary fields below)

tools.name: get_transfer
tools.description: Get the status and details of a transfer by ID. Use this to verify delivery after creating a transfer.

tools.name: list_transfers
tools.description: List transfers with optional filters. Uses cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: create_beneficiary
tools.description: Create a new transfer beneficiary (recipient) for sending money. The beneficiary can be reused across multiple transfers.

country.description: 2-letter country code (SG, MY, PH, US, etc.)

holder_name.description: Full name of the account holder

tools.name: get_beneficiary
tools.description: Get details of a transfer beneficiary by ID. Account numbers are redacted for security.

tools.name: list_beneficiaries
tools.description: List all transfer beneficiaries. Uses cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: create_refund
tools.description: Issue a full or partial refund for a completed payment. IMPORTANT: Refunds are irreversible — confirm the charge ID and amount with the user before executing. The payment_id is the charge ID (not the payment request ID).

payment_id.description: The charge/payment ID to refund (UUID format)

amount.description: Amount to refund. Must be <= original charge amount. Use the full amount for a complete refund.

webhook.description: Webhook URL for refund status notifications

send_email.description: Send refund confirmation email to customer

email.description: Customer email (overrides the one on the original charge)

tools.name: create_recurring_billing
tools.description: Create a new recurring billing subscription. Links a customer to a billing cycle. If plan_id is provided, the plan's amount/currency/cycle will be used. Otherwise, provide name, amount, currency, and cycle directly.

plan_id.description: Existing subscription plan ID (if set, uses plan amount/currency/cycle)

amount.description: Billing amount per cycle (required if no plan_id)

cycle_repeat.description: Number of cycles to repeat (for custom cycle)

times_to_be_charged.description: Total number of charges before auto-cancellation

tools.name: cancel_recurring_billing
tools.description: Cancel a recurring billing subscription. This stops all future charges. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

recurring_billing_id.description: Recurring billing subscription ID to cancel

tools.name: charge_saved_card
tools.description: Charge a saved card on demand for an existing recurring billing subscription. The subscription must have a saved card from a previous payment.

tools.name: create_webhook_event
tools.description: Register a webhook URL to receive event notifications. You can subscribe to specific event types like charge.created, transfer.paid, payment_request.completed, etc.

url.description: Webhook endpoint URL (must be HTTPS in production)

event_types.description: Event types to subscribe to: charge.created, charge.updated, payout.created, order.created, order.updated, invoice.created, transfer.created/updated/processing/scheduled/paid/failed/canceled, payment_request.completed/failed

tools.name: delete_webhook_event
tools.description: Delete a webhook event subscription. This stops all notifications to the webhook URL. This action is permanent.

tools.name: get_remitter
tools.description: Get details of a remitter by ID. Remitters are the sending parties in incoming transfers.

tools.name: get_supported_qr_methods
tools.description: Discover which QR payment methods are available for a given country or currency. Cross-references a static country→provider→method map against your live account status to show exactly which QR methods you can use with create_embedded_qr or create_static_qr. Set borderless=true to discover cross-border QR methods (e.g., SG merchant accepting GCash PHP payments).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (SG, MY, PH, IN, ID, VN, CN, TH)

currency.description: 3-letter currency code (SGD, MYR, PHP, INR, IDR, VND, CNY, THB)

borderless.description: Set true to discover cross-border QR methods available to your merchant country. Shows foreign payment methods you can accept with automatic FX conversion.
